headline: Bring Ecowitt weather readings into Home Assistant
intro: Ecowitt sends station readings to Home Assistant through a local webhook. Add the integration to get a server address, port, and generated path, then enter those details in the station’s Ecowitt upload settings so it can push data to Home Assistant.
highlights: The config flow creates a webhook ID and shows the server host, port, and path to use in Ecowitt
Incoming data can create sensor entities and binary sensors for leak, battery, and rain state
Entities are organized under station devices and update when the station sends new data

flow.title: Set up the local data path
stages: Copy the displayed host, port, and path
Configure the station to upload using the Ecowitt protocol
Receive station readings through the webhook
